bead.title: Specify hybrid-async poison and repair contract
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The ADR defines the hybrid-async acknowledgement boundary and SQLite lag, but it does not say when async apply enters a poisoned state, what remains authoritative while poisoned, or how repair returns the projection to service.

ROOT CAUSE: `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md:73` through `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md:83` define strict versus async apply ordering and SQLite high-water behavior, while `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md:85` through `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md:94` define recovery hydration, but neither section defines async poison triggers, repair authority, or fail-closed behavior during repair.

PROPOSED FIX: Update governing artifact `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md` to specify `hybrid-async` poison and repair rules. Define poison triggers for async SQLite apply gaps, high-water mismatch, hydration/image mismatch, checksum or segment replay failure, and repeated repair failure. State that the object log and hot memory projection remain authoritative for acknowledged commands, SQLite is not a response barrier, poisoned SQLite cannot authorize retention or recovery, and repair must replay from a trusted object-log/snapshot frontier before clearing poison.

NON-SCOPE: Code changes; implementing metrics, repair tools, or performance tests; changing existing evidence results; changes outside the four governing artifact references; altering existing dependency ID `pqueue-b207e65d`; weakening the required verification commands.

DEPENDENCY: parent `pqueue-b207e65d`.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestHybridAsyncPoisonRepairAdrSpec: `rg -n 'hybrid-async|poison|repair|sqlite_high_water|object log|fail closed|replay' docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md` succeeds and shows explicit async poison triggers, repair authority, fail-closed behavior, and object-log authority rules.
2. TestHybridAsyncPoisonRepairNoCodeScope: `git diff --name-only` after the bead contains only `docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-012-orthogonal-log-projection-composition.md`.
3. TestHybridAsyncPoisonRepairCargoGate: `cargo test -p pqueue-release ledger_path_honors_env_override_and_default` passes.
4. TestHybridAsyncPoisonRepairFmtGate: `cargo fmt --check` passes.
5. TestHybridAsyncPoisonRepairGoGate: `go test ./...` passes or records a no-Go-module skip with the exact command output.
6. TestHybridAsyncPoisonRepairLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
